summary: HeartSciences Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement (PIPE) of 411,522 common shares to Fortitude Mining Holdings at $2.43 per share, approximately $1.0 million gross, priced at the 30-day VWAP. The investment precedes the proposed business combination with Fortitude; the shares are not subject to the Exchange Ratio. The securities are unregistered, relying on Section 4(a)(2). Fortitude owns about 9.4% post-placement. This is a financing step, not a standalone special situation; the proposed merger is separately reported. Watch for merger closing progress and regulatory approvals.
